rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality hatching blastocyst, but it overstates confidence in AA features from a single focal plane and is somewhat imprecise on staging (4 vs 5) and TE/ICM visibility.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, AMH, diagnosis, first-cycle status, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors; only minor overinterpretation of image-based morphology.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET for a good-quality blastocyst and standard luteal support; minor softness around PGT-A discussion keeps it from perfect alignment.
Provides clear next steps for transfer, lifestyle, luteal support, and contingency planning for failed transfer or future family-building.
